description: Passive RC low-pass filter: J_IN feeds R1; C1 connects the output to ground. J_OUT exposes the filtered signal. Nominal unloaded cutoff is approximately 159 Hz.
assumptions: The inventory two-pin connectors serve as signal connectors: positive is signal and negative is ground.
The external signal source has low output impedance and the output measurement has high input impedance relative to 10 kohm.
R1 is 10 kohm and C1 is 100 nF. This passive filter needs no separate power supply.
